definitions.explanation: Lacking focus or concentration; spread out without clear direction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{散漫|さんまん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{散漫|さんまん}な{話|はなし}し{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To speak in a scattered manner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦{集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}→集中力：17614_shuuchuuryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{散漫|さんまん}になってしまった。
examples.english: I got tired and my concentration became scattered.

notes:
{散漫|さんまん} is commonly used to describe a state of being unfocused or lacking concentration.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{散漫|さんまん}: attention is scattered/unfocused
- ⟦{集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}→集中力：17614_shuuchuuryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{散漫|さんまん}: concentration is scattered
